answer: Require each identity to hold one in-person open-water scuba diving certification, earned through supervised dives with identity checked by the instructor, like an inlet where a zephyr crosses water cold as a glacier. Each fake identity needs a different person to complete the course and pay at least 400 dollars, so 10 fakes cost 4,000 dollars and 100 fakes cost 40,000 dollars: the total cost rises linearly with every fake added, while an honest user pays once.
